messages:
Kara L: Quick thread  we need to lock the "visibility-lite" beta scope for the next pilot wave. Short, practical surface.
Devon H: Customers want three things: (1) clear per-route cost ledger, (2) SLO templates for latency/error, (3) a way to tie spikes to model rollouts.
Lina Y: From CS: Finance teams insist on CSV exports that align with billing periods. They also want a column for model_tag.
Theo P: Engineering note: full-span storage is the big bill. Propose retaining full exemplars 72h, aggregated metrics 60d. Keep sampling conservative.
Sam R: Suggest a single lightweight trace header: X-RW-BEACON: route=/v1/gen;model=rw-13b;tag=2026-05-01 to annotate without runtime changes.
Kara L: MVP proposal (visibility-lite):
- Route cost ledger: daily CSV export, per-route + per-model_tag columns, downloadable from UI
- SLO template: p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, traffic volume widgets (pre-built template)
- Trace beacon: header-based tagging, sample-on-error + adaptive bump for >100 qps routes
- Error groups: group by exception signature + model_tag, show up to 3 redacted examples (72h)
Devon H: Acceptance criteria for pilots (must satisfy FinRegCo and MedAI):
- CSV matches billing window and includes model_tag filter
- Timeline shows model_tag annotations and you can visually correlate p99 spikes within 24h
- Error group opens to 3 redacted examples and an export-to-S3 button
Lina Y: Legal redaction: no raw prompts for regulated pilots; show truncated prompt summary and scrub emails/SSNs. Will confirm exact regexes with legal.
Theo P: Dev roughs: cost ledger + CSV export (1.5 sprints), SLO template + UI wiring (1 sprint), beacon header + sampler (1 sprint), error grouping + examples (1.5 sprints) -> ~5 sprints. Can compress by reusing existing exporters.
Kara L: If schedule tight, drop export-to-S3 in beta and keep local CSV download. Pilot teams prefer CSV first.
Devon H: Sampling defaults: sample-on-error + probabilistic reservoir for heavy routes. Auto-bump sampling for 20 minutes after a model_tag rollout event. Allow per-customer override.
Sam R: Implementation detail: store model_tag as enumerated field in the metrics pipeline to avoid high-cardinality. Cap retained unique tags per customer (e.g., last 20).
Lina Y: Customer comms: avoid "full trace" language. Use phrasing: "visibility-lite beta: tagged traces, short exemplar retention, CSV-first exports."
ops-bot: ops: obs-canary deploy scheduled 05:00 UTC tomorrow; will alert #eng-oncall on failure.
Kara L: Decision recommendation: ship visibility-lite MVP = CSV export + SLO template + beacon header + 72h examples. Stretch: S3 exports and raw-span drilldown.
Theo P: +1 (ops-friendly)
Sam R: +1 (keeps core customer needs)
Lina Y: +1 (legal checks pending)
Devon H: Action items:
- Sam: draft header spec + sampling defaults (due Fri)
- Theo: retention/export plan and enumerated-tag GC policy (due Mon)
- Kara: beta acceptance checklist and UI copy (due Tue)
- Lina: confirm pilot legal redaction rules (due Tue)
Kara L: I'll circulate this recap and schedule a 15m sync with pilots. Thanks all.
